proof_body:
by
  intro a b t₀ y₁ v₁ y₂ v₂ h₁ h₁' h₂ h₂' hy hv t
  let L : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).prod
    ((-a) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ - b • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ)
  have hL : ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ, L x = (x.2, -(a * x.2) - b * x.1) := by
    intro x
    simp [L]
  have hf : ∀ s, HasDerivAt (fun s => (y₁ s, v₁ s)) (L (y₁ s, v₁ s)) s := by
    intro s
    rw [hL]
    exact (h₁ s).prodMk (h₁' s)
  have hg : ∀ s, HasDerivAt (fun s => (y₂ s, v₂ s)) (L (y₂ s, v₂ s)) s := by
    intro s
    rw [hL]
    exact (h₂ s).prodMk (h₂' s)
  have heq : (fun s => (y₁ s, v₁ s)) = fun s => (y₂ s, v₂ s) :=
    ODE_solution_unique_univ (v := fun _ => L) (s := fun _ => Set.univ) (K := ‖L‖₊) (t₀ := t₀)
      (fun _ => L.lipschitz.lipschitzOnWith) (fun s => ⟨hf s, trivial⟩)
      (fun s => ⟨hg s, trivial⟩) (by simp [hy, hv])
  exact congrArg Prod.fst (congrFun heq t)
target_source: ∀ (a b t₀ : ℝ) (y₁ v₁ y₂ v₂ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ t, HasDerivAt y₁ (v₁ t) t) → (∀ t, HasDerivAt v₁ (-(a * v₁ t) - b * y₁ t) t) → (∀ t, HasDerivAt y₂ (v₂ t) t) → (∀ t, HasDerivAt v₂ (-(a * v₂ t) - b * y₂ t) t) → y₁ t₀ = y₂ t₀ → v₁ t₀ = v₂ t₀ → ∀ t, y₁ t = y₂ t
